import ast
from collections import Counter
import difflib
import importlib.util
import importlib.machinery
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import symtable
import sys

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
sys.path.insert(0, str(main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'))
import terminal_scan as S
from terminal_predicates import canonical_hash, check_frozen_hashes, load_json
out = main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part3/erratum7'

if sys.argv[1] == 'intake':
    old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '4662d03:'+S.RULES], cwd=main)
    new = (main/S.RULES).read_bytes()
    assert S.sha256(old) == 'ccbe8923bdca5962189a458d0d7f51d32c8bb7e8af0f10fe592b2d478e4f2f0b'
    assert S.sha256(new) == S.RULES_SHA
    a, b = old.splitlines(keepends=True), new.splitlines(keepends=True)
    edits = [r for r in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,a,b,autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if r[0]!='equal']
    assert len(edits)==2 and all(r[0]=='insert' for r in edits), edits
    previous_notice = '> **已生效勘误:附录 C 勘误 6(2026-10-07,FatTank 批准)。**\n'.encode()
    assert edits[0][1]==a.index(previous_notice)+1 and edits[1][1]==len(a), edits
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--',S.RULES],cwd=main))
    sys.stdout.flush()
    print('OLD_SHA256='+S.sha256(old))
    print('NEW_SHA256='+S.sha256(new))
    print(f'APPEND_ONLY=PASS additions={len(b)-len(a)} deletions=0 insert_blocks=2')
elif sys.argv[1] == 'cross-check':
    manifest, files = S.fixed_inputs(Path.cwd(), main)
    data = load_json(out/'preflight-final.json')
    expected = {e['path'] for e in manifest['entries'] if e['entry_kind']=='PY_SOURCE'}
    actual = [e['path'] for e in data['entries']]
    assert len(actual)==len(set(actual)) and set(actual)==expected
    assert data['summary']['participants']==len(data['participants'])
    assert data['summary']['zero_matches']==len(data['zero_matches'])
    assert data['summary']['multiple_matches']==len(data['multiple_matches'])
    independent=[]
    parent_kinds=Counter()
    for path in sorted(expected):
        source=files[path].decode()
        tree=ast.parse(source)
        parents={child:node for node in ast.walk(tree) for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node)}
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node,ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value,ast.Name) and node.value.id=='subprocess' and node.attr in {'run','Popen'}:
                parent=parents.get(node)
                if not (isinstance(parent,ast.Call) and parent.func is node):
                    assert any(isinstance(n,ast.Import) and any(a.name=='subprocess' and a.asname is None for a in n.names) for n in tree.body)
                    independent.append((path,node.lineno,node.col_offset,'subprocess.'+node.attr))
                    parent_kinds[type(parent).__name__]+=1
    measured=[(p['path'],p['line'],p['column'],p['qualified_name']) for p in data['zero_matches'] if p['kind']=='NON_CALL_READ']
    assert sorted(independent)==sorted(measured)
    print(f'PY_SOURCE_SET_EQUAL=PASS {len(actual)}/{len(expected)}')
    print('INDEPENDENT_SUBPROCESS_READS='+str(len(independent))+' '+json.dumps(parent_kinds,sort_keys=True))
    loaders=[p for p in data['zero_matches'] if p['qualified_name']=='importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader.exec_module']
    loader_evidence=[]
    targets={'tests/unit/test_design_drift_ledger.py':'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/design_drift_ledger.py',
             'tests/unit/test_workflow.py':'tizen-gbs-build-workflow/scripts/run_workflow.py'}
    assert {p['path'] for p in loaders}==targets.keys()
    for point in loaders:
        target=Path.cwd()/targets[point['path']]
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('metadata_only_never_loaded',target)
        assert spec is not None and type(spec.loader) is importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader
        method=type(spec.loader).exec_module
        record={'callsite':point['path']+':'+str(point['line']),'target':targets[point['path']],
                'target_sha256':S.sha256(target.read_bytes()),'loader_type':'importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader',
                'method_module':method.__module__,'method_qualname':method.__qualname__,
                'module_from_spec_called':False,'exec_module_called':False}
        loader_evidence.append(record)
        print('LOADER_METADATA_ONLY='+json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True))
    S.write_atomic(out/'cross-check.json',{'independent_reads':independent,'parent_kinds':parent_kinds,'loaders':loader_evidence})
    print('BLOCKER_CONTEXTS='+json.dumps(Counter(p['context'] for p in data['zero_matches']),sort_keys=True))
    print('PRECHECK_SHA256='+S.sha256((out/'preflight-final.json').read_bytes()))
    lines=['# E7-3 全树 PY_SOURCE 预检阻塞清单','',
      '来源:固定 HEAD `'+S.HEAD+'`,tree `'+S.TREE+'`;权威 SHA `'+S.RULES_SHA+'`。',
      '', '以下表由 preflight-final.json 机械生成,不是手工豁免清单。', '',
      '| 文件:行:列 | 上下文 | 被调限定名/读取对象 | 命中数 | 原因 |','|---|---|---|---|---|']
    for p in data['zero_matches']+data['multiple_matches']:
        reason='非调用读取,正文②′无形态承接' if p['kind']=='NON_CALL_READ' else '受监控调用,不在任何形态封闭被调者集合'
        lines.append(f"| `{p['path']}:{p['line']}:{p['column']}` | `{p['context']}` | `{p['qualified_name']}` | {p['match_count']} | {reason} |")
    lines+=['', '汇总: `'+json.dumps(data['summary'],ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)+'`。', '',
       '本预检不是完整消费者引擎/B-8/completion,不产生 OBS claim;后续块未执行。']
    (out/'blockers.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
elif sys.argv[1] == 'immutable':
    p,e=load_json(S.DATA/'predicates.json'),load_json(S.DATA/'measurement_exemptions.json')
    check_frozen_hashes(p,e)
    print('PREDICATES_CANONICAL='+canonical_hash(p))
    print('EXEMPTIONS_CANONICAL='+canonical_hash(e))
    paths=['tizen-*/scripts/**','ci_triage/','release-v1.4.0/','docs/clang-fix-campaign/design.md',
      'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/predicates.json',
      'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/measurement_exemptions.json',
      'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part2/',
      'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part3/erratum6/']
    check=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--exit-code','HEAD','--',*paths],cwd=main)
    assert check.returncode==0
    print('IMMUTABLE_AND_PRODUCTION_DIFF_EXIT=0')
else:
    raise SystemExit('unknown mode')
